title: Sanctuary at Seagrove | KEY.co
description_expanded: The outdoor spaces create a private retreat, complete with a heated resort-style pool and spa, an outdoor kitchen, and a cabana with a gas fireplace for relaxing evenings. Inside, multiple living and entertainment areas include a game room, custom bar, and wine cellar, providing plenty of space to gather and unwind. Each bedroom suite is designed with comfort and privacy in mind, featuring beautifully appointed ensuite bathrooms with custom stone and mosaic detailing. With private beach access, included bikes and a golf cart for exploring the area, and easy access to the charm, dining, and coastal experiences along 30A, this remarkable home offers a refined and memorable seaside escape. Perched along scenic 30A in Santa Rosa Beach, this extraordinary three-story coastal estate is designed for elevated gatherings and unforgettable beachside living. Thoughtfully crafted with luxurious finishes and expansive living spaces, the home blends refined architecture with a relaxed coastal atmosphere. The main living level features a stunning chef’s kitchen with dual islands, premium appliances, custom finishes, and open shelving, all designed to make entertaining effortless. Just beyond, the spacious living room opens to sweeping wraparound porches with large glass doors that frame breathtaking Gulf views and overlook the private courtyard and resort-style pool below.
